items.title: Taaruf: bare, chhote aur halke ajza (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the unnumbered introduction, printed page 305.

blocks.text: Atmosphere (fiza) zameen ke gird mukhtalif gases ka ek kura (sphere) hai. Atmosphere ke ajza (components) ko teen hisson mein baanta ja sakta hai: major (bare), minor (chhote) aur trace (bohat thori miqdar wale). Major components nitrogen (78.00%) aur oxygen (21.01%) hain. Minor components argon (0.93%) aur carbon dioxide (0.04%) hain. Trace components methane, hydrogen, neon, helium, krypton aur xenon hain.

blocks.caption: Atmosphere ki banawat (composition)
rows: methane, hydrogen, neon, helium, krypton, xenon

blocks.prompt: Carbon dioxide hawa ka sirf minor component hai. Phir bhi yeh climate ke liye itni aham kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh atmosphere ka sirf taqreeban 0.04% hai, lekin carbon dioxide zameen se nikalne wali garmi (infrared) ko jazb (absorb) karti hai. Is liye is ki miqdar mein thora sa izafa bhi zyada garmi rok leta hai (greenhouse effect, 14.7). Nitrogen aur oxygen, jo major gases hain, is tarah infrared jazb nahi kartin.
